channel.title: Thoughts — Paymanshu Sharma
channel.description: Essays on machine learning, agents, and engineering by Paymanshu Sharma.

item.title: Large Language Model Optimization: Memory, GPU, and CPU
item.description: A practical tour of LLM deployment optimization across three dimensions — precision formats and quantization for memory, batching and KV caching for GPU, and IPEX and llama.cpp for CPU.

item.title: On-Device Large Language Models on Android
item.description: Why running LLMs on phones is worth the trouble, and two working Android demos — a RAG document-querying app built on Phi-3-mini and ONNX Runtime, and a multi-LoRA adapter-switching app on Gemma 2B.
